Title: MFLA-MK3
Product Description:
The MFLA-MK3 is a horizontally symmetrical 2-way powered line array featuring dual 12-inch neodymium woofers and dual 3-inch compression drivers. It delivers substantial output with wide 120-degree horizontal coverage and arrays with up to 19 additional cabinets. Fixed-hinge flyware supports both flying and ground-stacked deployments, driven by 3200W of DSP-equipped Class D amplification with remote control.

  • Dual 12-inch neodymium woofers and dual 3-inch compression drivers, 120-degree horizontal dispersion

  • 3200W Class D amplification with 96kHz DSP, 8 accessible presets, 100-preset storage

  • Fixed-hinge flyware for flying or ground-support, arrays up to 20 cabinets
